children.title: Experiment Impact Tracker
children.description: A Python library that calculates the carbon cost of a machine learning job; unmaintained, archived October 2025.

children.title: claude-carbon
children.description: An MIT-licensed Bash and SQLite tool that tracks the carbon footprint of Claude Code agent sessions, with a live CO2 estimate in the status line, per-model reports, shareable PNG report cards, and a published methodology.

repo_info.description: claude-carbon: track the carbon footprint of your Claude Code sessions

children.title: AXIOMAX ESG Carbon Shield
children.description: An MIT-licensed SDK for Python, Node.js, and Bash that signs AI inference calls with ed25519 and SHA-256 hash chains to produce auditable carbon attestations for CSRD and SEC reporting; calibration coefficients and keys remain server-side, and the project advertises a pending USPTO patent.

repo_info.description: Cryptographically verifiable ESG carbon attestation for AI inference. Patent Pending USPTO 64/081,419. Open-source verifier in Python/JS/Bash. Run offline.

children.title: ebb-ai
children.description: An Apache-2.0 MCP server exposing nine tools that defer non-urgent LLM jobs to the cleanest grid hour within a deadline across 31 regions, logging per-task carbon receipts to SQLite. (source)

repo_info.description: Carbon-aware MCP scheduler for agentic AI workflows. Defer "do it later" tasks to the cleanest electricity-grid hour inside a deadline — 40–70 % lower CO2, 50 % cheaper via Batch APIs. Apache-2.0.

children.title: carbontracker
children.description: Tracks and predicts the energy consumption and carbon footprint of training deep learning models, as described in Anthony et al. (2020).

repo_info.description: Track and predict the energy consumption and carbon footprint of training deep learning models.

children.title: FedZero
children.description: A federated learning system for zero-carbon distributed AI training, successor to Lowcarb, which won the GSF CarbonHack 2022. (paper)

repo_info.description: [ACM e-Energy'24] Code and data for "FedZero: Leveraging Renewable Excess Energy in Federated Learning"

children.title: Green Cost Explorer
children.description: A climate-related spend analysis for AWS from the Green Web Foundation; unmaintained, archived September 2023.

repo_info.description: See how much of your cloud bill is spent on fossil fuels ,so you can do the right thing and switch. We're in a climate crisis, remember?

children.title: Cloud Jewels
children.description: An MIT-licensed set of energy-estimation coefficients and scripts converting GCP billing data into trailing 30-day kWh estimates for CPU, GPU, memory, storage, and network; unmaintained since 2020. (blog post)

repo_info.description: Estimate energy consumption using GCP Billing Data

children.title: kube-green
children.description: An open-source Kubernetes add-on that automatically shuts down selected resources when you do not need them.

repo_info.description: A K8s operator to reduce CO2 footprint of your clusters

children.title: Carbonifer
children.description: A command-line tool to estimate and control the carbon emissions of cloud infrastructure before it is provisioned.

repo_info.description: Control carbon emission of your cloud infrastructure - Carbon-aware cloud infra

children.title: Kernel Tuner
children.description: An auto-tuner capable of optimizing GPU code for energy efficiency.

repo_info.description: Kernel Tuner

children.title: Creedengo (formerly ecoCode)
children.description: SonarQube plugins for PHP, Python, Java, JavaScript, and more, providing static analyzers that highlight code structures with a negative ecological impact.

repo_info.description: Reduce the environmental footprint of your software programs with SonarQube

children.title: Tracarbon
children.description: Tracks a device's energy consumption and calculates carbon emissions using your location.

repo_info.description: 🌍 Tracarbon tracks your device's energy consumption and calculates your carbon emissions using your location.

children.title: JoularJX
children.description: Java software power monitoring at the source code level, in real time.

repo_info.description: JoularJX is a Java-based agent for software power monitoring at the source code level on all OSes

children.title: energy-consumption-measuring-toolkit
children.description: Accenture's RAPL-based toolkit for measuring the energy consumption of Python applications.

children.title: CarbonLint
children.description: An MIT-licensed Tauri/Rust desktop app and npm CLI that tracks CPU, memory, disk, network, and GPU use, converts it to CO2 via regional grid intensity, and scores projects 0-100.

repo_info.description: CarbonLint is a real-time system profiler that tracks your computer's energy consumption and calculates its carbon footprint. It helps developers understand the environmental impact of their work and make greener choices.

children.title: carbon-text
children.description: A syntax highlighter and snippets extension for carbon.txt files.

repo_info.description: A green syntax highlighter & code snippets extension for carbon.txt files. 🌿

children.title: Green CodeQL
children.description: A GPL-3.0 collection of custom CodeQL queries flagging energy-related sustainability issues across six packs covering Java/Kotlin, Python, C/C++, JavaScript, C#, and GitHub Actions.

repo_info.description: CodeQL Analysis for sustainability

children.title: Carbon Aware SDK
children.description: A Web API and command line for unified forecast and historical power grid emissions data by location and time, to help build carbon-aware software.

repo_info.description: Carbon-Aware SDK

children.title: Carbon Aware Computing — Tools and Free Forecast Data
children.description: A NuGet package, PowerShell cmdlets, and a live SDK instance, plus an open carbon forecast for Europe in the Carbon Aware SDK's JSON format.

repo_info.description: Execute tasks on a point in time with minimal grid carbon intensity

children.title: Compute Gardener Scheduler
children.description: An open-source Kubernetes scheduler plugin that simplifies both time and location shifting of flexible compute workloads to lower-carbon or cheaper grid hours, using real-time carbon intensity data and time-of-use prices, with workload energy budgets, Kepler power metrics, and a dry-run admission webhook to evaluate savings.

repo_info.description: www.compute-gardener.com

children.title: GreenScheduled
children.description: An Apache-2.0 Java library adding a annotation for Spring Boot and Quarkus that shifts jobs to the lowest-carbon hour in a window using the carbonintensity.io API.

repo_info.description: The carbonintenistyio scheduler is a java library that enables systems to run their scheduled processes in the greenest window available

children.title: Carbon Aware Computing Hangfire Extension
children.description: A Hangfire extension that schedules tasks into the window of minimal grid carbon intensity, based on emission forecasts.

repo_info.description: Execute Hangfire tasks with carbon awareness in mind.

children.title: PSElectricityMaps
children.description: A PowerShell module for retrieving current power grid carbon emissions data with a free Electricity Maps or CO2signal account.

repo_info.description: PowerShell Module for free ElectricityMaps API functions for Azure

children.title: Carbon AppInsights
children.description: An Azure Functions solution logging Electricity Maps emissions data for Azure regions into Azure Monitor for alerting triggers and automated actions.

repo_info.description: Azure Function for logging PSElectricityMaps results for Azure regions to Application Insights

children.title: PSWattTime
children.description: A PowerShell module for retrieving current power grid carbon emissions data with a free WattTime.org account.

repo_info.description: PowerShell module for WattTime API free functions

children.title: scaphandre
children.description: Power measurement for bare-metal hosts, Prometheus, and workloads inside Docker containers.

repo_info.description: ⚡ Energy consumption metrology agent. Let "scaph" dive and bring back the metrics that will help you make your systems and applications more sustainable !

children.title: Kepler
children.description: The Kubernetes-based Efficient Power Level Exporter uses eBPF to probe energy-related system stats and exports them as Prometheus metrics.

repo_info.description: Kepler (Kubernetes-based Efficient Power Level Exporter) is a Prometheus exporter that measures energy consumption metrics at the container, pod, and node levels in Kubernetes clusters.

children.title: Eco-CI
children.description: A plugin for GitHub Actions and GitLab that measures CI runs and estimates their energy use.

repo_info.description: Eco CI Energy estimation for Github Actions, GitLab and Jenkins

children.title: PowerJoular
children.description: Monitors the power consumption of software and hardware components in real time.

repo_info.description: PowerJoular allows monitoring power consumption of multiple platforms and processes, on Windows, Linux and macOS

children.title: Vessim
children.description: A co-simulation testbed for carbon-aware applications, connecting renewable generation and energy storage simulators to real software and hardware; published at HotCarbon'24. (source)

repo_info.description: A co-simulation testbed for microgrids and energy-aware systems 🍃

children.title: GreenIT-Analysis
children.description: A DevTools extension measuring a website's ecoIndex and verifying the web eco-design best practices defined by the Collectif Numérique Responsable.

repo_info.description: GreenIT-Analysis

children.title: PowDroid
children.description: A GPL-3.0 off-device Android energy profiler, written in Go and Python, deriving energy metrics from a device trace via CLI or GUI.

repo_info.description: PowDroid is a tool to estimate the energy consumption of Android applications and devices.

children.title: creedengo-ios
children.description: A SonarQube plugin highlighting code structures in iOS projects that may have a negative ecological impact.

repo_info.description: Reduce the environmental footprint of your Swift-based iOS apps with SonarQube

children.title: ipmitool
children.description: Reads the power consumption of a bare-metal machine through DCMI, the IPMI extension.

repo_info.description: An open-source tool for controlling IPMI-enabled systems

children.title: PowerTOP
children.description: A Linux tool to diagnose issues with power consumption and power management.

repo_info.description: The Linux PowerTOP tool  -- please post patches to the mailing list instead of using github pull requests

children.title: turbostress
children.description: Generates load on a machine and outputs the computer's power metrics for that load.

repo_info.description: Computer power measurement tooling

children.title: WedeexApp
children.description: An MIT-licensed UWP sample app in C# demonstrating the Wedeex API by showing real-time French grid CO2 intensity and Microsoft Surface power draw. (blog post)

repo_info.description: This repos is about sharing an example of UWP application that relies on Wedeex API's

children.title: CO2.js
children.description: An npm module for accessing the Green Web API and estimating the carbon emissions of digital services.

repo_info.description: An npm module for accessing the green web API, and estimating the carbon emissions from using digital services

children.title: ec0lint
children.description: A static code analysis tool providing hints for reducing the carbon footprint of websites.

repo_info.description: Create sustainable digital environment with ec0lint

children.title: Carbonara
children.description: A custom element from Digital4Better that displays the carbon footprint of web navigation.

children.title: Architectural Tactics to Optimize Software for Energy Efficiency in the Public Cloud
children.description: Interviews with 17 practitioners produced a reusable model of architectural tactics for cloud energy efficiency, though provider opacity still prevents straightforward energy-aware design decisions.

children.title: Awesome AI Tokenomics
children.description: Roughly 190 tools, papers, and benchmarks for monitoring, optimizing, and governing LLM token cost and waste, including an energy and carbon category.

repo_info.description: A curated list on AI token economics: what tokens cost, where they get wasted, and how to cut the bill. Tools, benchmarks, papers, and copy-paste configs for the token economy of LLMs and coding agents.
